title: Clifton community centre
titleCn: Clifton社区中心设施与活动介绍

paragraphs.text: Part two.
You will hear a recorded telephone information message about the facilities and events at a local community center.
First, you have some time to look at questions eleven to seventeen.
Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to seventeen.
Thank you for calling the Clifton Community Center information line. You will not be charged for this call.
Clifton Community Center operates as a resource for the whole area to provide access to a wide range of facilities and organized events for all age groups and interests.

We run a small cafe, The Rainbow, with very reasonable prices. We serve tea, coffee, and cakes every morning until twelve, and then from noon until two thirty, we serve midday meals, chiefly salads. We try to make sure there is always at least one vegetarian option.
A number of different clubs, classes, and social events are currently being run at the center.
Every day before lunch, a toddlers playgroup is run, which is open to all children between the ages of one and three.
All children must be accompanied by a parent or other carer.
Please note that activities are not suitable for babies under twelve months.
The group provides the opportunity for preschool children and carers to socialize and offers a variety of activities.
There are supervised art and craft sessions run by the playgroup leader two or three times a week.
There is also a wide range of climbing apparatus for the children, all meeting rigorous safety standards. And on Friday mornings there's a story which the children always love.
If you're interested in joining the group, please call the center on 6367812 or leave a message on the center email for Mrs. Gough.
I'll spell that. G-O-U-G-H. Then she'll contact you.
On Wednesdays from three to four PM, we run the exercise class for men and women of all ages.
It mainly concentrates on stretching and is particularly beneficial for older people and people with any mobility problems.
However, people of any age who do not want to do rigorous aerobic exercises will also find it extremely helpful.
Please bring along your own mat as unfortunately we're not able to provide these.
Our very popular quiz nights are run on the first Tuesday of each month. These are open to everyone and there's always an exciting prize for the winning team.
Before you hear the rest of the message, you have some time to look at questions eighteen to twenty.
Now listen and answer questions eighteen to twenty.
For arrangements about payment and booking for these clubs and events, please press one on your phone now.

You are now through to the booking and payment information line. The playgroup costs two pounds a session and we do ask parents to sign up a week in advance as places are limited. The exercise class costs three pounds a session and you can pay this when you come to the class.
There is no charge for the quiz nights.
The charge of one pound, which was formerly made, has now been discontinued.
If you have any further queries about the center, please call the helpline number or visit the website on www.clifton.org.
